import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score

# Create submission directory if it doesn't exist
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data
train = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

# Separate features and target
y_train = train["target"]
feature_cols = [col for col in train.columns if col not in ["id", "target"]]
X_train = train[feature_cols]
X_test = test[feature_cols]

# Split training data into train/validation (stratified to maintain class balance)
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

# Prepare CatBoost with categorical feature handling
# Mark f_27 as categorical since it's the high-cardinality string feature
cat_features = ["f_27"]
params = {
    "iterations": 1000,
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "depth": 6,
    "loss_function": "Logloss",
    "random_state": 42,
    "verbose": False,
    "early_stopping_rounds": 50,
    "use_best_model": True,
}

# Train CatBoost model with early stopping
from catboost import CatBoostClassifier

model = CatBoostClassifier(**params)
model.fit(X_tr, y_tr, cat_features=cat_features, eval_set=(X_val, y_val))

# Evaluate on validation set using AUC-ROC
val_predictions = model.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_predictions)
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC Score: {val_auc:.6f}")

# Make predictions on test set
test_predictions = model.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]

# Create submission file with correct format
submission = pd.DataFrame({"id": test["id"], "target": test_predictions})
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
